headline: Data & Business Analytics | SQL - Tableau - Power BI - dbt - Snowflake - MicroStrategy
summary: Senior Business Analyst with 6+ years turning large, complex datasets into business decisions using SQL, Tableau, and Power BI. Delivered dashboards that 15+ regions relied on for real-time visibility, and rebuilt one at the data source to cut load time by 75% for 40+ users.

bullets.text: Write SQL to validate data quality and map data structures across large reporting systems, then present designs for approval before building in production.
Translate ambiguous business requirements into technical specifications, partnering with IT to build the datasets, cubes, and reporting pipelines that serve them and meet SLAs.
Manage delivery like a project, running stakeholder meetings, resolving data-validation fixes, and escalating blockers to leadership.
Lead new reporting pilots end-to-end in MicroStrategy and Excel/SSAS, owning the test approach, scenarios, and scripts through UAT sign-off.
Built Tableau dashboards that 15+ regions relied on for real-time visibility into market share and pricing trends across Nielsen and internal sales data.
Cut dashboard load time by 75% for 40+ users by rebuilding the dashboard at the data source level.
Reconciled data issues with SQL, Python, Snowflake, and dbt before they reached leadership.
Turned business requirements into dashboard specs for major retail accounts across grocery, club, and e-commerce channels.
Wrote queries to catch data errors across large reporting systems for audit reconciliations.
Diagnosed why audit cases stalled in review and documented common causes to improve backlog processing times.
Built an end-to-end Python analysis pipeline over 12.4M+ retail transactions, using Claude for LLM-assisted exploration.

Surfaced that 1 in 4 products barely sell and that organic items outperform their shelf allocation by 2-3x, checking every model-surfaced pattern against source data before it informed a recommendation.
